Meta.keywords: Durood Shareef, Durood Ibrahimi, tasbeeh counter, salawat counter, Friday durood, Noor-e-Durood
Meta.title: Noor-e-Durood — Send Durood together
Meta.description: Recite Durood Shareef upon the Holy Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and add your count. Everyone's durood adds up to one shared total.

Install.title: Install the Noor-e-Durood app
Install.sub: Open it from your home screen; tasbeeh works even without internet

Notices.paused: Adding durood is paused for a little while. Keep reciting: your tasbeeh count stays safe on this phone and will be added later.

Admin.loginRateLimited: Too many tries. Try again in 15 minutes
Admin.removeBody: {count} will be taken back off the total, today, this month and the device's count.
Admin.pausedHint: Shows a gentle notice on the home page; tasbeeh counts stay saved on phones. Takes effect within about 10 seconds
Admin.announcementHint: Leave empty to show no announcement
Admin.fridayHint: Leave empty to use the built-in hadith message
Admin.recalcHint: Safety tool: rebuilds every counter (total, each day, each month) from the entries.
Admin.recalcBody: All counters will be rewritten from the entries that aren't removed. Run it when traffic is low: durood arriving at that exact moment could be missed.
Admin.disableBody: {user} won't be able to log in or add anything. Past entries stay as they are.
Admin.resetPinBody: Type a new 4-digit PIN for {user} and tell them. They'll be logged out on all phones.
Admin.majalisHint: Users pick their majlis from this list in their profile. Anyone not listed can choose "Other" and type a name.
Admin.leaderboardShowNames: Show names and profiles on the leaderboard
Admin.leaderboardShowNamesHint: When off, the leaderboard shows only rank and count, names appear as "Anonymous" and profiles don't open. Takes effect within about a minute
Admin.loginWithAdminAccount: To open the admin panel, first log in with your admin account (mobile number and PIN), then enter the admin password.
Admin.notAdminAccount: The account you're logged in with is not an admin. The admin panel only opens for admin accounts.
Admin.setupNotice: There is no admin account yet, so the password alone opens the panel. Use "Make admin" on your own account in Users; after that the panel needs both an admin account login and the password.

Offline.title: You're offline
Offline.body: There's no internet, but you can keep counting your tasbeeh. The count is saved on this phone and added automatically once you're back online.

Hero.title: Let us send Durood and Salaam upon the Holy Prophet ﷺ together
Hero.subtitle: However much durood you recite, add it here. Together, every count becomes one light.

Counter.unavailable: Couldn't load the count right now. Trying again shortly.

Tasbeeh.offline: You're offline. Your count is safe and will be added once you're back online.
Tasbeeh.retryLater: Couldn't add it just now. Your count is safe; we'll try again shortly.
Tasbeeh.mThousand: Allahu Akbar! {n} durood complete. May Allah accept it
Tasbeeh.resetBody: Only the count on screen goes back to zero. Durood already added, or still waiting to be added, stays safe.
Tasbeeh.loginToSave: Your count is saved on this phone. Log in or create an account to add it.

Durood.shortTranslation: May Allah send blessings and peace upon him ﷺ and his family.
Durood.ibrahimiTranslation1: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad ﷺ and upon the family of Muhammad ﷺ, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
Durood.ibrahimiTranslation2: O Allah, send barakah upon Muhammad ﷺ and upon the family of Muhammad ﷺ, as You sent barakah upon Ibrahim (peace be upon him) and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed, You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

Footer.dua: May Allah accept the durood of all of us. Ameen
